name: padma-ai-plugins
description: Plugins for working with PADMA CRM, Money, and Learn from Claude Code.

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Administer authorized Learn schools through the teacher MCP: publications, students and access, subscriptions, courses, modules and members, bookings, guest booking pricing, check-ins, and attendance reports.

plugins.name: money
plugins.description: Consult account balances at a date, enriched contacts and plans with payment debt over an explicit monthly range, and manage authorized PADMA Money businesses safely through its remote MCP server.

plugins.name: crm
plugins.description: Consult authorized PADMA CRM contacts, Operations project members and sections, multi-project tasks, collaborators, recurrence, comments, task change history, activity, statistics, and funnel data, and safely create or update supported records.

plugins.name: padma
plugins.description: Coordinar CRM, Money y Learn mediante sus plugins MCP: relacionar alumnos y contactos con identificadores verificados, consultar accesos y asistencia, actividad comercial, planes y movimientos financieros, conservando organizaciones, permisos y fuentes independientes.
